rules: A sentence may state a figure only through a claim: metric id, value, scope, window, sample size and source body travel together.
Comparisons between windows (up, down, beat, record) are computed from two claims of the same metric by code, never by the writer.
A developer or project is attributed to a figure only through a registered project_id (lk_identity_xref), never by name.
A window whose last day is less than two days old is provisional: the DLD register back-fills (8 Sep 2026 read 526 sales on 9 Sep and 641 by 10 Sep).
A figure below its minimum sample is not stated, and the claim says so.

claims.label: Registered transactions (sales, mortgages and gifts)
claims.source: Dubai Land Department transactions register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Rows of the transactions register inside the window that pass the shape gate: a dated instance, group Sales, Mortgage or Gifts, and a value (when present) above zero and under AED 5 bn.

claims.definition: Transactions in group Sales inside the window, after the shape gate. By area: the register's own AREA_EN label.

claims.label: Value of sales
claims.source: Dubai Land Department transactions register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Sum of TRANS_VALUE over sales with a numeric value, in billions of dirhams, rounded to one decimal.

claims.label: Median sale price
claims.source: Dubai Land Department transactions register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Median TRANS_VALUE over sales with a numeric value.

claims.label: Median residential sale price per square foot
claims.source: Dubai Land Department transactions register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Median of TRANS_VALUE divided by ACTUAL_AREA (square metres) over residential sales with an area above 10 m2, divided by 10.7639 to give dirhams per square foot.

claims.label: Off-plan sales
claims.source: Dubai Land Department transactions register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Sales whose IS_OFFPLAN_EN is Off-Plan.

claims.label: Ready (completed) sales
claims.source: Dubai Land Department transactions register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Sales whose IS_OFFPLAN_EN is Ready.

claims.label: Rent contracts registered
claims.source: Dubai Land Department Ejari rent contracts register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Ejari contracts in the window that pass the shape gate: a dated registration, version New or Renewed, and an annual amount (when present) between AED 1,000 and AED 5 m.

claims.label: Residential single-unit contracts
claims.source: Dubai Land Department Ejari rent contracts register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Residential contracts for a Unit or Villa with an annual amount, excluding bulk leases (TOTAL_PROPERTIES above 1 - the 48.9% phantom-yield lesson).

claims.label: Median annual rent
claims.source: Dubai Land Department Ejari rent contracts register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Median ANNUAL_AMOUNT over residential single-unit contracts.

claims.label: Median annual rent per square foot
claims.unit: AED per sq ft per year
claims.source: Dubai Land Department Ejari rent contracts register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: Median of ANNUAL_AMOUNT divided by ACTUAL_AREA over residential single-unit contracts with an area between 10 and 10,000 m2, divided by 10.7639.

claims.label: Gross rental yield
claims.source: Dubai Land Department Ejari rent contracts register (DLD open data) and Dubai Land Department transactions register (DLD open data)
claims.definition: 100 x median annual rent per m2 (residential single-unit contracts, 10-10,000 m2) / median sale price per m2 (residential sales above 10 m2), the same area on both sides once marketing names are mapped to DLD areas through data/dld/area_alias.json. Stated only with at least 30 contracts AND 30 sales, and only inside the 1.5-12% canary band.
